summary.zh: 新增客户端 Antigravity（agy）：只靠一份驱动声明、夹具和随包的 hooks.json 与 mcp_config.json 接入。install、update（卸载后重装）、check、sync、nudge hook、inventory、doctor 认识 agy；不在默认客户端集合里，须 --client agy。
summary.en: Antigravity (agy) is a declared client: one driver declaration, fixtures and the shipped hooks.json and mcp_config.json. install, update (uninstall then reinstall), check, sync, nudge hook, inventory and doctor know agy; it is not in the default client set, name it with --client agy.
